premises.text: Uncertainty about liking a new place keeps people at the same old spots
premises.evidence_span: you still end up at that same old coffee shop. And why does that happen? It happens because we don't want to take the chance and try to go to a new place because we're not sure that we're going to like the experience

premises.text: Recommendations are personalized from Facebook/Foursquare history and differ per user, with friends' ratings as the social proof layer
premises.evidence_span: all the places that you'll see are actually completely personalized for me based on where I've checked into on Foursquare and what I've rated

premises.text: App makes preference capture fun and each contribution improves recommendations for the contributor and for other users
premises.evidence_span: One, it helps SpotOn make my experience better. But more interestingly, it actually helps the experience of everybody else who uses SpotOn

premises.text: Product tells you not only where to go but who among friends would enjoy going with you
premises.evidence_span: SpotOn even tells me who I should go there with. So not only is it telling me what places I should go, it also tells me who else would enjoy this place with me

premises.text: Filters/search present top recommendations, bookmarks, friends' loves, and personalized categories simply
premises.evidence_span: you have access to your top recommendations, your bookmarks, even places your friends love with one tap of a button

value.text: Find new places to enjoy with friends with less wasted decision time
value.evidence_span: We do not want you to spend a lot of time wasting, trying to figure out where to go. We want you to actually find a place that you're enjoying, spend more time actually enjoying the place with your friends
